name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: ⚠️ A warning when every entrance on a hive is closed: in red on Home when the app opens (tap the hive to open it), and on the hive's Edit screen.
🚪 The front entrance's opening is Open, Large, Small or Closed (Large is the reducer's middle opening; Small is near the end you pick). The bottom board's deep or shallow side is no longer asked.
🔲 The DS Board's Plain or w/doors sit on its own line.
🍯 Feeder units (gallons, quarts, liters, lbs) no longer break in half on a small phone.
